jobs.description: At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The roleFor our global Mature Customer Marketing team in Berlin, we are looking for a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the lifecycle strategy for one these topics: merchandising, or partnerships & retail media. The Mature Customer Marketing team sits within the HelloFresh Group’s Global Customer Lifecycle organization. Our mission is simple: keep active customers active, and make sure they get the most out of their subscription — across our 6 brands, 18 countries and 30 markets.As a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you’ll be a critical link between strategy and execution, partnering closely with CRM, Product Marketing, Physical Product, Tech and local marketing teams to design, brief and scale programs that keep our customers engaged with their subscription.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What you’ll do- Own the lifecycle strategy deployment for your topic area and translate it into programs and campaigns that keep customers engaged with their subscription- Partner with Product Marketing, Physical Product and Tech to spot opportunities that improve the customer experience and support your topic’s goals- Brief campaigns end-to-end to CRM Operations and Creative teams, ensuring messaging, targeting and execution meet our lifecycle and brand standards- Work with local market teams across our 30 markets to adapt and roll out global strategy, balancing consistency with local relevance- Use data to test, measure and continuously optimize campaign performance- Track and report on the health of your topic area, flagging risks and opportunities to the wider Customer Engagement team- Support cross-topic initiatives across the team as neededWhat you’ll bring- Strong project management skills, with experience managing complex campaigns across a high number of cross-functional stakeholders, including CRM Operations, Creative, Tech, and local teams.- Strong creative briefing skills — experience translating marketing objectives, audience insights, and messaging needs into clear, inspiring briefs that give creative teams the direction and context needed to deliver strong work.- Commercial acumen — experience operating in a commercial function (not necessarily CRM), with the ability to bridge lifecycle marketing thinking with commercial opportunities.- A successful experience (3+ years) in CRM, lifecycle marketing, product marketing or a similar role, ideally in a subscription, e-commerce or FMCG environment- An analytical mindset — comfortable using data to inform decisions and optimize campaigns- Ability to manage multiple priorities independently, across global and local stakeholders- Fluent in English; notions of German, French, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian or Danish is a plus- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business or a related fieldWhat we offerCompensation & Financial Wellbeing- You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.- Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.- Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.Health & Wellbeing- Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.- Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.Flexibility & Work-Life- Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.- Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.- Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.Career & Development- Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.Culture & Environment- Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.- We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.Are you up for the challenge?Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Marketing-Management, Projektmanagement, Customer-Relationship-Management (CRM)

Lead Project Manager India (m/f/x)Wieland-Werke AG I Pune (India), Ulm I Business Unit Thermal Solutions I Ident. Code 2026-0210 I immediatelyUnleash potential.Copper connects the world - in technologies, such as eMobility, energy and data transfer, refrigeration and air conditioning technology, digitalization and the Internet of Things. Surprise us with your fresh thinking, new impulses and shape the world of tomorrow. Discover numerous opportunities to unleash your potential.Wieland stands for diversity and equal opportunities - for this reason, we welcome individual applications regardless of age, gender, nationality, religion, ethnic and social background.Lead Project Manager India (m/f/x) Your FutureTake the lead in building something extraordinary! Based initially at Wieland's headquarters in Ulm, Germany, you will drive the establishment of a completely new heat exchanger manufacturing plant in Pune, India. As the central project lead, you will take responsibility for this strategic greenfield investment – from initial planning and site preparation through construction, start of production and successful ramp-up. You will act as Wieland's key representative throughout the project, bringing together international stakeholders and shaping the future of our Thermal Solutions Business Unit in one of the world's most dynamic markets. This is a unique opportunity to combine entrepreneurial freedom, broad responsibilities and international collaboration while building a new manufacturing operation from the ground up.- Project Leadership: You take overall responsibility for the greenfield investment, driving scope, schedule, budget, quality and risk management from initial site preparation through construction, start of production and successful ramp-up. You establish and manage project governance, including steering committee reporting, milestone tracking and preparation of decision papers for management.- Plant Set-up: You lead the planning and establishment of the new manufacturing facility, covering factory layout, production processes, infrastructure, utilities, equipment procurement, installation and commissioning in close collaboration with our international engineering teams.- Joint Venture & Entity Set-up: Acting as Wieland's key representative on site and central point of contact, you manage the day-to-day relationship with the Indian joint venture partner and drive the establishment of the new legal entity in close cooperation with our Legal, Finance and Tax functions.- International Collaboration: You coordinate closely with our Thermal Solutions manufacturing sites in Italy, the USA and China, including the Manufacturing Engineer based in Italy, as well as corporate functions in Germany.- Supply Chain & Commercial Development: Together with Purchasing and Sales, you establish a reliable local supplier base, support early customer engagement and drive the commercial groundwork for the new Indian operation.- Organization & Team Development: Starting with a small core project team, you build the local organization from the ground up and develop a strong team across production, quality, maintenance, and support functions.- Operational Excellence: You embed Wieland values, production standards and EHS requirements from day one. You lead the start-up and ramp-up towards stable performance in safety, quality, delivery and cost, ensuring a structured handover to the local operational management.Your Potential- Education: You hold a degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering or a comparable technical or business-related field. An MBA with a specialization in Project Management is considered an additional qualification.- Professional Experience: You have several years of professional experience in project management, ideally in industrial manufacturing, plant engineering or a comparable technical environment. Experience in heat exchangers, HVAC/R or metal processing is an advantage.- Project Management: You have successfully managed technical projects, such as investment, plant construction, equipment or production projects. Experience with greenfield projects or plant expansions is a plus.- Leadership: You have initial leadership experience, either in a disciplinary role or as a project lead, and are motivated to take on broader entrepreneurial responsibility.- Entrepreneurial Mindset: You are a hands-on, pragmatic all-rounder who enjoys taking ownership across different disciplines. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, navigating uncertainty and getting things done in a dynamic, evolving environment.- International Experience: You have experience working in international environments and are confident collaborating across cultures. Exposure to India, Indian business practices or joint venture structures is an advantage.- Personality: You combine strong organizational and communication skills with resilience, flexibility and a proactive approach. You know how to build trust, bring different stakeholders together and drive decisions – from the construction site to senior management level.- Languages: Fluent English is essential. German and Italian language skills are considered an advantage, as is knowledge of Hindi and Marathi, particularly for communication with local stakeholders in Pune.- Mobility: You are willing to undertake extensive international business travel, particularly between Germany, India, Italy, the USA and China. You are also willing to relocate to Pune, India, for at least three years to lead the implementation, start-up and ramp-up phases of the project.Your Benefits- Entrepreneurial Freedom: Take ownership of a strategic greenfield investment and build a completely new Wieland manufacturing site from the ground up, with significant scope to shape its future.- High Visibility & Responsibility: Work closely with senior management of

spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.What you will ownLead the DACH Test Business- Own the overall commercial performance of the Test business across Germany, Austria, improvement.- Align individual strengths and expertise with strategic market opportunities.- Establish clear development and succession plans for key roles.- Raise the overall standard of consultative, value-based, and solution-oriented selling.Win in a Competitive Market- Develop differentiated strategies for strategic accounts and competitive opportunities.- Build strong account and territory plans that increase market penetration and customer value.- Lead competitive positioning across the Test & Validation landscape.- Govern Proof-of-Concept engagements with clear success influence regional and global strategy.- Drive adoption of the broader Siemens portfolio by connecting test, measurement, simulation, engineering software, and services into compelling customer solutions.- Ensure operational excellence through accurate forecasting, disciplined opportunity management, reliable demonstrations, and measurable sales performance.What You BringWe are looking for an accomplished Sales Director, Business Leader, or Commercial Leader who combines strong sales leadership with a deep understanding of engineering-driven technology markets, especially in test & validation.- A successful track record in B2B sales leadership within engineering software, test & measurement, validation, simulation, industrial technology, or a closely related field- Experience leading Sales and PreSales organizations with direct responsibility for regional business performance.- A proven record of winning complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.- Strong experience developing strategic accounts and building long-term relationships with senior engineering and executive decision-makers.- Experience selling solutions such as test & measurement, data acquisition, test automation, validation, simulation, NVH, HIL/XIL, engineering software, or related technologies is highly valuable.- Strong commercial judgment and demonstrated success in negotiations and complex deal structures.- The ability to translate sophisticated technology into clear customer value and compelling business outcomes.- with strategic partners and developing indirect routes to market.- Strong understanding of industries such as Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Electronics & Semiconductors, Energy, and Industrial Machinery.- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.- Willingness to travel regularly across the DACH region and internationally.- Highly proficient spoken and written German and English.Why UsWe are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!Our Benefits & RewardsThe primary locations for this opportunity are Austria, Germany, and Switzerland. jobs.description: html Expert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH with more than 200 employees is a subsidiary of the Octapharma group founded in 1997 and successfully expanding. Our core business is the development of recombinant proteins produced in human cell lines for therapeutic use in humans. We strive for effective treatments with an improved tolerability and convenience for our patients.Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.We are looking for anExpert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)to join the Automation and Data Management unit within the Research and Development Department at Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH.The Automation and Data Management unit is responsible for the development, evaluation and long-term maintenance of automation- and data-driven solutions across R&D. The unit supports scientific projects by combining laboratory automation, data management, bioinformatics and scientific computing, and is involved in the work of multiple research units and virtually all projects within the department.The successful candidate will take on a challenging and versatile role with a strong focus on scientific computing, molecular modelling and high-performance computing (HPC). jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams.TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) asInstrument Scientist Toftof (m/f/d) You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.Your tasks include:Scientific lead of TOFTOF’s further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications.Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOFExperimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performanceMethod development in the area of neutron spectroscopyOperation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operationPursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methodsYour responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field.Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial.Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team.Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profilePersuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset.For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.deThe high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees.We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such asTUM's health offersUniversity sportsTUM's internal continuing education and training opportunitiesTUM childcare (subject to availability)Very good accessibility by public transportThe position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed.
